company: Leibniz Universität Hannover / L3S - Soofi II LLM-training GPU tender
why_now: The need is unmet now. The open procedure closed on 21 Oct 2026 with zero tenders for both lots: result notice 762871-2026 (3 Nov 2026) codes both lots 'clos-nw' (no winner, competition closed), with not-awarded reason 'no-rece' and 0 tenders received. Service windows in the notice: Lot 1 must start between 1 Dec 2026 and 15 Jan 2027 (1,024 B200/B300-class GPUs for 65 days, then 128 GPUs to day 155; option of up to 3 more months with 128 GPUs). Lot 2 must start between 15 Jan and 1 Apr 2027 (2,048 GB200/GB300 NVL72 GPUs for about 56 days; option of up to 3 more months with 2,048 GPUs). TED shows no re-tender as of 23 Nov 2026. After an open procedure with no tenders, § 14(4) no. 1 VgV lets the buyer use a negotiated procedure without a new call, provided the original conditions are not fundamentally changed. A re-procurement may therefore not be publicly advertised, so direct contact now is the only way in.
what_they_do: Public university. It is the contracting authority for the 'Soofi-Projekt', a German consortium building sovereign open-source LLMs (LUH's L3S Research Center is a partner). It tendered GPU and CPU capacity to pretrain and post-train Mixture-of-Experts LLMs.

residency_note: The notice requires 'Standort EU/EWR oder ein Land mit einem Angemessenheitsbeschluss der EU'. The UK qualifies: the EU renewed the UK adequacy decisions on 19 Dec 2025, valid to 27 Dec 2031 (EC IP/25/3059). Both Raion's UK and EU sites meet the location rule.
fit_caveats: Short bursts (Lot 1: 1,024 GPUs for 65 days then 128 GPUs to day 155; Lot 2: 2,048 NVL72 GPUs for about 56 days) against Raion's 12-36-month terms, and Raion's 120-180-day go-live cannot meet Lot 1's 1 Dec 2026-15 Jan 2027 start; Lot 2's latest start (1 Apr 2027) is borderline. Terms in the notice: payment needs a bank guarantee of 100% of the lot value; the buyer may terminate a lot if the full cluster is not delivered and accepted within 30 days of service start. Location rule: EU/EEA or an EU-adequacy country (UK qualifies; adequacy renewed 19 Dec 2025), though the eForms place-of-performance code is DEU, so confirm a UK site with the buyer. After zero tenders, German law (§14(4) no. 1 VgV) allows a negotiated procedure without a new notice, so contact the procurement mailbox and the L3S project managers directly. The first Soofi compute contract (about 130 DGX B200 systems from Mar 2026) went to T-Systems' Industrial AI Cloud (Telekom, 19 Nov 2025).

why_now: CEO Ganesh Gopalan (AIM, 5 Sep 2026): 'The key constraint has been GPUs and it will be GPUs ... Especially today when it is really so tough to get hold of any form of compute.' Roadmap: CTO (Business Standard, 18 Feb 2026): 'The next one is 14 billion parameters, and then we plan to go to 32 billion, and eventually around 70 billion over the next year' ... 'The 70-billion-parameter one in about a year' (about Feb 2027). Evon v3.3 (30B MoE, 2T tokens) unveiled 28 Aug 2026; Inc42 reports plans for 70B and 100B models. The $10M Series B (31 Mar 2026) is a first close of a larger round.
what_they_do: Bengaluru voice-AI company that builds its own Indic speech and language models (Inya VoiceOS 5B voice-to-voice model; Evon v3.3 30B open-weight MoE LLM) and enterprise agent platforms (Inya, Plexus), packaged as the 'Artha' sovereign AI stack. Selected under the IndiaAI Mission to build an indigenous foundation model.
funding: Series B first tranche: $10M announced, led by Aavishkaar Capital with Info Edge Ventures (Business Standard and Inc42, 31 Mar 2026). The AI Insider (1 Apr 2026) cites regulatory filings showing $7.17M allotted.; 2026-03-31; total raised USD 10780000
compute_evidence: CTO, Business Standard, 18 Feb 2026: 'We have a five-billion-parameter model as a preview. The next one is 14 billion parameters, and then we plan to go to 32 billion, and eventually around 70 billion over the next year.' / 'We get access to GPUs - up to around 1,500 GPUs through the IndiaAI Mission. That is critical for training these models.' CEO, AIM, 5 Sep 2026: 'The key constraint has been GPUs and it will be GPUs.'
est_blocks: About 0.25 of a block (shared or fractional)
residency_note: HQ is in India. Gnani sells Artha/Evon on Indian data residency and on-prem/self-hosted deployment. As an IndiaAI grantee it has subsidised Indian GPUs, so inference for Indian customers will most likely stay in India. Raion's UK/EU/US/Canada sites fit training runs on non-personal data and serving overseas customers as it expands globally. Round trips between India and the UK/EU are typically over 100 ms. That is fine for training and batch work but marginal for real-time voice serving Indian callers.
fit_caveats: Core training runs on subsidised IndiaAI GPUs hosted in India, and Artha is pitched on Indian data residency, so inference for Indian customers will stay in India. A ~$10M round cannot fund a full block. Realistic deal: fractional/shared capacity for 70B/100B training on non-personal data or for serving overseas customers. Total raised is at least about $11-14M (filings show INR 68 Cr allotted plus $4M from Info Edge in 2024).
